models.name: todo_list_todousers
models.description: Represents a single authenticated todo user ("todoUser" actor) who can sign up, log in, and manage their own todo items. Each user is uniquely identified by their email, which must be unique and not null. Stores credential and minimal profile information (email, password hash) and audit fields for registration and account changes. Used as the reference owner for all related todos via foreign key from the business domain. Passwords are stored as secure hashes only.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address of the user. Must be a valid email and unique across all users. Used for authentication and login.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt or secure hash of the user's authentication password. Never stores plaintext. Used for verifying login credentials.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of account creation. Used for audit and registration history.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to user account. Updated automatically when profile or credentials change.

models.name: todo_list_todouser_sessions
models.description: Session records for each login/authentication event of a todo user. Each session is directly owned by a single todo user and represents a persistent login/token session (for JWT, refresh, etc). Audit fields include IP, connection context, creation and optional expiry timestamps. Sessions are referenced by session tokens and provide a complete login/session audit log for each user. Managed through the identity/authentication system. Sessions are not exposed for independent CRUD and are always subsidiary to the owning user.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the client at session creation time. Used for audit and session context.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL (entry point or referer) for traceability. Used for session context in audits.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer or origin URL when session was established. Used for session traceability.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp. Used for session audit and ordering.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiry or logout time. Nullable; if null, session is still valid.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description: A todo business entity owned strictly by a single todoUser. Each record represents a personal todo item with title, optional description, completion status, timestamps, and ownership reference. Enforces all business constraints as required: only the owning user can create, view, update, complete, or delete the todo. No sharing, delegation, or multi-user relations exist. Business validation (title and description rules, unique id, timestamps, and state transitions) is handled at the field level. Tightly coupled to {@link todo_list_todousers} for ownership and permission enforcement.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_todouser_id
foreignFields.description: Owner's {@link todo_list_todousers.id}. Enforces strict ownership; only the referenced todoUser can manage this todo.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short, required title of the todo item. Cannot be empty or whitespace-only; maximum 100 characters per business rule.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional details or notes for the todo. May be empty or null; must not exceed 500 characters if present.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the todo is completed (true) or not (false). Only boolean values are allowed per requirements. Business logic ensures consistent state transitions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created. System-assigned; required for traceability.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the last modification of the todo. System-assigned; required for audit traceability.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was marked as completed. Required and set only when is_completed is true; must be null or omitted when is_completed is false. Used for audit/history. Nullable as per business rule.
